name: rstack
description: Requirements-first agent engineering stack: state, question, and delete requirements across plans, code, status reports, and dev cycles.

interface.shortDescription: Requirements-first engineering meta-skills: state, question, and delete requirements for any plan, codebase, status report, or dev cycle.
interface.longDescription: rstack organizes agent engineering around a unified requirements model and a hierarchical skill DAG: system-diagram, state-requirements, question-requirements (fresh subagent with deep web OSS research and minimal worktree spikes), delete-requirements, opt-in auto-plan, measure-dev-cycle, scope-work, and status-report.
capabilities: Deterministic Mermaid stateDiagram-v2 generation and validation with metrics
Unified requirement stating, fresh-subagent questioning, and verified deletion
Empirical GitHub + local dev-cycle profiling and work scoping
interface.defaultPrompt: Run state-requirements on this plan or feature.
